rationale: The Evaluator feedback and race data from iteration 0 show no finishes and moderate steering oscillation (~0.25). The previous candidate increased base_speed to 1.4 and slightly reduced kd to 0.4 to encourage faster progress and reduce oscillations, while keeping ki at 0.2 and line_loss strategy at 'search_left'. However, no race data is yet available for that candidate. The Evaluator suggests trying 'search_right' for line_loss and slightly lowering ki to 0.15 to balance stability and responsiveness, as well as adjusting sensor_weights to [-1.2, -0.6, 0, 0.6, 1.2] to improve signal quality and reduce oscillations. I adopt these changes to test if a gentler integral action and a different line loss recovery direction improve line recovery and reduce oscillations, while the reduced sensor weight magnitudes may smooth the control signal. Geometry remains unchanged to isolate controller effects. I expect to see reduced steering oscillation, fewer line loss events, and improved progress in the next race. I request measurements including completion, progress, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to verify these hypotheses.
